title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Susceptibility Phenotype

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Susceptibility: Phenotypic susceptibility — isolate, not genotyping', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Susceptibility of a microbial isolate to a substance, excluding observables that assert a genotyping technique (ECL cardinality [0..0]). Matches the phenotype ValueSet intent (MIC, disk diffusion, gradient strip ... any phenotypic method). Parts: LOINC enumeration (1230, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. purpose.value: Guidance for binding Observation.code of the MII microbiology request profiles to a computably defined LOINC set; accompanies ballot comments on 2027.0.0-ballot2. Generated, not hand-curated.
